title: Reject broad visual intent links and accept exact Item links
preconditions: Use the valid v5 Saga fixture with a story criterion, a deck, a slide and a node Item.

steps.action: Attempt explains and addresses links from the whole deck and whole slide to the whole story.
steps.expected_result: Each operation rejects with slide Item guidance and no relation is written.

steps.action: Create explains and addresses links from the node Item to the criterion.
In a disposable valid fixture, hold each story or criterion target constant and attempt explains/addresses links from deck, slide and Item sources.
steps.expected_result: For either target and relation kind, deck and slide sources are rejected; exact Item sources are accepted.
